test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A 300-m-long train crosses an electric pole in 5 s. Find the speed of the train.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train = 300 m

Time = 5 s

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculations:**

Considering the train as stationary and pole mobile

According to the question,

Speed = (300)/(5) = 60 m/s

Now converting m/s to km/h = ( (60 × 18))/(5 )=( 1080)/(5) = 216 km/h

**∴ The speed of the train is 216 km/h.**
